0.original: Stigma-4 has a shocking request.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Speak with the guardian Ea and mount the Miw Miisv.

25.original: Use Electric Flux to electrify intellectuals.

48.original: Commencing status report. Analysis of infantile Miw Miisv on Elysion indicates advanced proficiency in generating electrical stimuli.

49.original: Verbal testimony from guardian Ea suggests contact with said bimodal output results in distinctive “sensations” in the non-corporeal subject. Such subjective experiences are predicted to positively impact environmental dynamis.

50.original: Requesting assistance from closest organic life-form. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, please report to the abode of the Ea and receive instruction on the electrocution of consenting non-corporeal beings.

51.original: You must be the corporeal one I am to instruct. Very good─I would have you guide this Miw Miisv to administer electrotherapeutics upon two of my brethren whose rumination often takes them to Hollow of the Flesh.

52.original: Unadulterated lightning is quite striking, you know. The semifluidity of your form suggests a tendency towards parboiling, but you are nevertheless free to partake should you desire swift liberation from your mortal coil.

53.original: Did this child's movements overwhelm you? I do hope you make up in determination what your corporeal form so evidently lacks in coordination.

54.original: If there were but stimuli strong enough to rouse me from this torpor...

55.original: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.

56.original: My appendages tingle─my mind races! My thoughts transcend, I grasp the universe's innermost secrets...aaand they're gone. Profane exclamations!

57.original: Transcendence, woooooo! ...Ahem. I mean, of course, that you may proceed to anoint me with the stimuli.

58.original: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.

59.original: Aaaaaaaaah! Cascades of revelation, oceans of understanding! The risk of dependency looms, but the mind wants what it wants!

60.original: ...<hex:021A020203>Ahem<hex:021A020103>. Do pardon my outburst─although we no longer possess the nervous systems of mortal meat sacks, one's consciousness still craves the occasional refreshment.

61.original: But to think that similar impulses once coursed throughout our systems at the slightest movement... How delightfully primitive!

62.original: Yes, I believe we shall soon grasp the nature of our erstwhile selves with regular exposure to these <hex:021A020203>sensations<hex:021A020103>. Do come and stimulate me again.

63.original: Pardon me, but I cannot but notice your current engulfment. Could you possibly facilitate the experience of “sensation”? My colleagues expound much upon its benefits, of late...

64.original: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.

65.original: Th-This is it! The very pseudo-physical euphoria I have heard so much about!

66.original: At last, you return! My colleagues strive to surpass my comprehension─you must facilitate my stimulation at once.

67.original: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.

68.original: My psyche tingles! My consciousness sings!

69.original: With this stimulation, I feel assured of my comprehension of “sensation”─yet one question still plagues my mind. If the classic corporeal creature spends its waking moments inundated by such perceptions, how does it manage to accomplish anything at all?

70.original: Already I am consumed by the urge to succumb to temptation once more... But no─I must not relinquish my rationality. I shall ensure that my colleagues recognize my superior understanding ere delving into the pleasures of the imagined flesh...

71.original: Return of <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> confirmed. Elevated levels of static electricity detected. Requesting summary of completed mission.

72.original: Verbal analysis complete. Subjects successfully achieved states of agitation and fleeting delusion of corporeal status by means of severe electrocution. Mission success.

73.original: Nicety protocol engaged. Well done, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Please accept this shiny recompense and lend your services to our cause once more.
